description: Shows ADR progress, state, and collaboration across checkouts

specs.description: Command outputs JSON when stdout is not a terminal
specs.given: hexa adr board is run with stdout redirected to a file
specs.then: the output is valid JSON containing the board data

specs.description: Command fails when no ADRs are found
specs.given: docs/adrs/ directory exists but contains no ADR files
specs.then: the command exits with code 1 and outputs {ok:false, code: 'no_adrs', message: '...', hint: '...'}

specs.description: A heading is a unit exactly when it matches the phase-id pattern
specs.given: Any heading line under `## Phases`
specs.then: It is a unit exactly when it is `### <id>.` with `<id>` one to three letters, a number and optionally one lowercase letter (`R1`, `P2a`, `F1` are; `R`, `ABCD1`, `R1A`, `Decision gate (R1)` are not)

specs.description: Non-phase headings are not counted as units
specs.given: an ADR with '### Decision gate (R1)' under '## Phases'
specs.then: the decision gate heading is not counted as a unit

specs.description: Phase is built when its section contains '**Built'
specs.given: an ADR with '### R1. Title\n**Built 2026-11-14.'
specs.then: the phase is marked as built

specs.description: Phase is not built without evidence
specs.given: an ADR with '### R1. Title' and no '**Built' line
specs.then: the phase is marked as not built

specs.description: State is computed from status and units
specs.given: An ADR with status Accepted and two phases, neither built
specs.then: Its state is `accepted`

specs.description: Retired status is not counted in progress
specs.given: an ADR with status 'superseded'
specs.then: the ADR is not counted in units or built

specs.description: Summary rounds down and excludes retired/unknown
specs.given: Two ADRs: one Accepted with 1 of 2 phases built, one Superseded with 3 phases
specs.then: `units` is 2, `built` is 1, `percent` is 50, and the Superseded ADR counts only in `by_state.retired`

specs.description: Drift is detected when status is behind evidence
specs.given: a 'proposed' ADR with a built phase
specs.then: the drift list contains 'status-behind-evidence'

specs.description: --strict exits 1 when drift is found
specs.given: an ADR with drift
specs.then: the command exits with code 1

specs.description: Elsewhere entries show differences between checkouts
specs.given: two worktrees with the same ADR but different status
specs.then: the elsewhere entry has kind: 'status'

specs.description: Uncommitted changes are only noted for 'text' differences
specs.given: a worktree with uncommitted changes to an ADR
specs.then: the elsewhere entry has kind: 'text' and uncommitted: true

specs.description: Tasks are joined to ADRs by name or ID
specs.given: a task in .hexa/tasks.json with name 'ADR-2611151030'
specs.then: the ADR row shows claimed_by with the task's owner

specs.description: Gate presence is shown
specs.given: One ADR that records a gate and one that records none
specs.then: The first row shows `gate: recorded` and the second `gate: none`

specs.description: Honest failure: no ADRs is an error, not silence
specs.given: docs/adrs/ directory is empty
specs.then: the command exits with code 1 and outputs an error message

specs.description: --product reads a separate repository's ADRs
specs.given: a kairos repository with its own ADRs
specs.then: the output contains a separate board for kairos with its own summary

specs.description: --also is for same-repo checkouts only
specs.given: a directory with ADRs from a different product
specs.then: a warning is output suggesting to use --product instead

specs.description: HTML page is static and inert
specs.given: an ADR with '<script>alert(1)</script>' in its text
specs.then: the script tag is escaped and not executed in the output

specs.description: The HTML page carries no script and no external reference
specs.given: An ADR whose title is `` and whose body links `https://example.com/style.css`
specs.when: `hexa adr board --html FILE` writes the page
specs.then: FILE contains no `<script`, no `src=` or `href=` pointing outside the file, and no unescaped `<` or `>` from the ADR's text; the CSS is inline

specs.description: Phases are units; a phase-less ADR is one unit
specs.given: An ADR whose `## Phases` has `### P1.`, `### P2a.` and `### Notes`, and an ADR with no `## Phases`
specs.then: The first ADR has two units, P1 and P2a; the second has one

specs.description: Status alone never builds a unit
specs.given: Any Accepted or Proposed ADR with any phases and no `**Built` line anywhere
specs.then: No unit of it is built; and a header `**Built:** P2` builds P2 only, never P2a

specs.description: Some units built is building
specs.given: An Accepted ADR with phases P1 and P2, only P1 carrying a `**Built` line
specs.then: Its state is `building`

specs.description: Every ADR has exactly one state, and it follows its units
specs.given: Any ADR
specs.then: Its state is exactly one of built, building, accepted, proposed, retired, unknown: retired for Superseded, Rejected, Deprecated or Abandoned; unknown when the status line cannot be read, with a warning naming it; otherwise built when every unit is built, building when some are, and accepted or proposed by status when none are

specs.description: Unknown and retired ADRs never move the percentage
specs.given: An ADR whose status line cannot be read, with three phases, beside a fully built ADR
specs.then: `percent` is 100 and the unreadable ADR counts only in `by_state.unknown`

specs.description: The percentage rounds down, and 100 means done
specs.given: Any set of ADRs
specs.then: `percent` equals floor(100 * built / units) over ADRs neither retired nor unknown, so it is 100 only when every such unit is built

specs.description: Drift is exactly a Proposed status behind its evidence
specs.given: Any ADR
specs.then: It is `status-behind-evidence` exactly when its status is Proposed and its state is building or built; `--strict` exits 1 exactly when at least one ADR is

specs.description: An elsewhere entry names the first difference and whether it is in flight
specs.given: Any ADR present in the current checkout and in another worktree or `--also` checkout
specs.then: An `elsewhere` entry exists exactly when the copies differ; its `kind` is status if the status word differs, else progress if units built differ, else text; `uncommitted` is true exactly when `git status --porcelain` shows that ADR file changed in that checkout; an unreadable checkout is a warning, never left out silently

specs.description: A finished or unrelated task is not attached
specs.given: A `done` task whose name contains the ADR's id, and a `running` task whose name, gate and leases contain neither the ADR's full id nor its ten-digit number
specs.then: Neither task appears in that ADR's `claimed_by`

specs.description: A live task is attached exactly when it names the ADR
specs.given: Any `claimed` or `running` task in `.hexa/tasks.json`
specs.then: It appears in an ADR's `claimed_by`, with name, owner and status, exactly when its name, gate or a lease contains that ADR's full id or ten-digit number

specs.description: The board never runs a gate
specs.given: An ADR whose recorded gate is a command that would create a marker file
specs.then: The marker file does not exist afterwards

specs.description: Every row says whether a gate is recorded
specs.given: Any ADR
specs.then: Its row has `gate` equal to `recorded` or `none`, and no gate result

specs.description: A warning is shown, not swallowed
specs.given: `docs/adrs/` holding one readable ADR and one whose status line cannot be read
specs.then: Both ADRs are listed, the second with state `unknown`, and `warnings` names it

specs.description: No ADRs is an error, never an empty board
specs.given: Any directory with no `docs/adrs/`, or one with no ADR file in it
specs.then: It exits 1 with `{ok:false, code:"no_adrs"}` and never prints a board with zero units

specs.description: Products never mix
specs.given: Any `--product DIR` alongside this repository
specs.then: DIR's ADRs appear only on DIR's own board with its own summary, worktrees and ledger; this repository's units, built and percent are the same as without `--product`

specs.description: Every ADR value is escaped in the page
specs.given: Any ADR text containing `<`, `>`, `&` or quotes
specs.then: Every such character from ADR text appears escaped in FILE, which contains no `<script` and no reference to anything outside itself
